text:
(ESA 2022) Mark the only correct option according to the text below.

Cash Flow Problem
“Honey, you have to tell me how we are spending our money”, said the wife to her husband. “I should know about these things.”
“Fine”, said the husband. “we are spending 25 percent on rent, 20 percent on the kids, 30 percent on food, 15 percent on clothes, and 40 percent on the cars.”
“But honey, that’s 130 percent.”
“I know. That’s the problem”
options: The husband is complaining to her wife about her personal expenses.
The wife is very happy because the couple is saving money.
The husband wants to know how his wife is spending their money.
The couple is spending more money than they make.
The couple is spending as much money as they make.
subject: Inglês
explanation:
(A) The husband is complaining to her wife about her personal expenses. ❌
Incorreta porque o marido não está reclamando dos gastos pessoais da esposa.
Na verdade, ele está explicando como eles gastam o dinheiro como casal.

(B) The wife is very happy because the couple is saving money. ❌
Incorreta e totalmente oposta ao sentido do texto.
A esposa está preocupada com os gastos.
Não há nenhuma menção de economizar ou ficar feliz.

(C) The husband wants to know how his wife is spending their money.❌
Errada, pois quem quer saber é a esposa.
O marido está explicando como ele (ou eles) estão gastando.

(D) The couple is spending more money than they make. ✔️
Correta!
Eles gastam 130% do que ganham (acima de 100%).
Essa é justamente a piada/ironía do diálogo: o problema é estarem gastando mais do que recebem.

(E) The couple is spending as much money as they make. ❌
Errada.
Gastar “as much as they make” seria 100%.
O problema no diálogo é que ultrapassa (130%).
